steps.action: Tap '+ Add enquiry'; in 'Add enquiry' fill 'Name', 'Code', 'Mobile number', 'Interested in (optional)', 'Where did they hear about us? (optional)', 'Follow-up date'; save
user_sees: Title 'Enquiries', subtitle 'People who asked about joining'
'No enquiries yet' before
Hint 'Call back on <day> (<when>)' or 'No date: it goes under Later.'
The new row with its call-back day
must_not: Two rows from a second press after a failed send
A message sent to the person
A follow-up day in the past accepted

steps.action: On the follow-up day tap the make-member button ('Make <name> a member'); finish the Add member form and Sell membership
user_sees: The filled-in Add member form
The row turns 'Joined' with 'Open member'
must_not: A second member with the same number
Money shown as collected when nothing was paid
The enquiry left open after the member was saved, with no word

start: Owner taps the quick button that opens Enquiries with the add sheet open at once

steps.action: Open the add-enquiry address
user_sees: The 'Add enquiry' sheet over the list
must_not: The sheet opening again after it is closed
A blank page

start: Owner online; a friend came through a member’s invite link and has now joined; the gym gives free days

steps.action: On the friend’s row ('Referred by <member>') tap 'Give free days'; in 'Thank <member>' confirm
user_sees: Sheet 'Free days added'
must_not: The days added twice on a second tap or a retry
Days added to a member with no running plan
A receipt made for free days

steps.action: Look at the row again
user_sees: '<member> got <n> free days for this friend.'
No 'Give free days' button
must_not: The button back after a reload

start: Owner online, Settings → Member app → Bring a friend

steps.action: Type a number in 'Free days for each friend who joins' and save; then empty it and save
user_sees: A line that a member gets <n> free days for each friend who joins
After emptying: 'No free days for a friend who joins.'
must_not: Free days given by themselves without the owner’s tap
The member app still promising the old number after its refresh

start: Owner on the Add enquiry sheet

steps.action: Save with no name, a 9-digit number, or a past follow-up date
user_sees: A problem line under the wrong box
must_not: An enquiry saved without a usable number
Typed values wiped

steps.action: Type a number that an open enquiry or a member already has
user_sees: '<name> already asked from this number (call back <day>). You can still save.' or '<name> is already a member with this number.'
must_not: The save blocked for a family number
No warning at all

steps.action: Convert an enquiry whose number belongs to a member
user_sees: Sheet 'Already a member' or 'Already a member (archived)' with a way to open or restore
must_not: A duplicate member

start: Owner online with one open enquiry due today

steps.action: Tap the change-date button; in 'Call <name> again' pick a later day
user_sees: The row moves under Later with 'Call back <day>'
must_not: 'The follow-up date can’t be in the past.' missing for a past day

steps.action: Tap 'Not interested'
user_sees: Bar '<name>: marked not interested.' with Undo
'Why did <name> not join? (optional)' on the row
must_not: The enquiry deleted

steps.action: Tap Undo, or later 'Reopen' under the 'Not interested' filter
user_sees: The enquiry open again with its old call-back day
must_not: A second copy of the enquiry

start: Owner reads enquiries that came from the gym web page, an online join and a friend invite

steps.action: Open such rows
user_sees: 'Asked on your web page', 'Chat on your web page', 'Asked to join online: <plan>, from <day>, <amount>. Paid.' or 'Not paid yet.', 'Referred by <member>'
'No number left yet' when the visitor gave none
must_not: Another gym’s enquiries
The friend’s details shown to the member who invited them
A WhatsApp sent by opening the row

steps.action: Tap '+ Add enquiry', fill 'Name', 'Mobile number', 'Follow-up date', save
user_sees: The new row with its call-back day
must_not: Two rows
A message sent to the person

steps.action: Tap the call or WhatsApp link on the row, then the make-member button and finish the forms
user_sees: The phone’s dialler or WhatsApp opens with nothing sent by itself
The row turns 'Joined'
must_not: A WhatsApp sent without staff pressing send in WhatsApp
A duplicate member

start: Staff taps the quick button for a new enquiry

steps.action: Open the add-enquiry address
user_sees: The 'Add enquiry' sheet
must_not: A refusal page (staff may add enquiries)

start: Staff online; a referred friend has joined and free days are ready to give

steps.action: Look at the friend’s row
user_sees: 'Referred by <member>'
No 'Give free days' button and no reward note until the owner has given
must_not: Staff able to move a plan’s last day
A dead button

steps.action: Save an enquiry with a wrong number
user_sees: A problem line under the box
must_not: A bad row saved

start: Staff online with an open enquiry

steps.action: Tap 'Not interested', pick a reason under 'Why did <name> not join? (optional)', then 'Reopen'
user_sees: Bar '<name>: marked not interested.'
Pill 'Not interested', then the open pills again
must_not: The reason lost on reopen without a word
The enquiry deleted

steps.action: After the owner gives the free days, reload
user_sees: '<member> got <n> free days for this friend.'
must_not: A give button for staff

steps.action: Open rows from the web page and from friend invites
user_sees: Names, numbers and what they asked
must_not: Money totals of the gym
Enquiries of another branch the staff does not work at
